title: Wren and the Oath
premise: Cyrus Galloway has spent his life in the valley of Hollowmere, where an old oath suppresses all magic and keeps its people invisible to the crown. When the usurper King Aldric's witch-hunters breach the valley's borders, Cyrus learns the truth: his late mistress bound her own memory into the valley's wards, and only someone carrying her gift can reopen the door to Vael, a country erased from every map. Fleeing with Wren, a hunter's daughter who chose him over her father's orders, Cyrus must reassemble his mistress's scattered memories before Aldric's armies reach the free cities. In the end, Cyrus unlocks the door but learns that passing through means surrendering every memory of Hollowmere, including Wren; he chooses to stay and rebuild rather than escape whole, sealing the door behind them so the valley's people may live unhidden.
about_author: Juniper Montrose is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing forgotten regional folktales before turning to fiction. She writes quiet, character-driven fantasy about ordinary people caught in the machinery of history.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgot Itself
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Years after fleeing his mistress Maren's cottage, Cyrus lives quietly as a tanner until witch-hunters arrive asking questions no outsider should know to ask. He discovers Maren died leaving him her grimoire and a warning: the valley's peace was bought with a stolen country. The beat is dread disguised as routine—the moment safety becomes a lie.

chapters.title: What the Hunter's Daughter Knew
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Wren, sent ahead as a scout for the hunt, recognizes Cyrus from childhood and conceals his name from her father, Captain Brannoc. She brings him Maren's first memory-shard, hidden in the village well, and learns the valley's elders knowingly fed travelers to the ward. The beat is loyalty fracturing—love pulling against blood and duty.

chapters.title: The Door in the Unmade Country
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Hunted across the moors after Brannoc discovers Wren's betrayal, Cyrus gathers the final shards inside a standing stone circle where Vael still faintly exists. There he faces Maren's preserved will: the door opens only for one willing to forget what anchors him. The climax arrives as Aldric's vanguard crests the ridge and Cyrus must choose.

chapters.title: An Oath Kept Broken
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Instead of escaping alone, Cyrus shatters the door's binding, releasing Maren's memories back into the valley so its people remember Vael—and themselves. The wards fall, but the free cities' armies, summoned by Wren's earlier message, arrive to turn the usurper's hunt into a war he cannot win. The resolution is bittersweet: home kept, innocence lost, love chosen over forgetting.
